mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.board_id, u.nick_name, p.title, p.content, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.view_count, p.like_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardType, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BoardTypeHandler} and p.is_delete = false ORDER BY p.created_at ASC

SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.board_id, u.nick_name, p.title, p.content, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.view_count, p.like_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardType, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BoardTypeHandler} and p.is_delete = false
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{writer}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
